effect: The handset inspection automatically connected it to the desk, producing replies and confirming that the first local requests were answered. Both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The distinction between a proposed solution and completed work was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Turning Moth's proposed rounds into volunteer-agreed work was most worthwhile: the neighbors identified a two-person carry and chose its priority, and the eventual replies showed what happened.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to pair the receipted requests directly with the dispatch handset was frustrating; the requests needed several intermediate stages before the handset could use them.

surprise.text: The appeal was accepted, but its three-working-day response time made it no immediate solution to the dawn deadline.

arbitrary.text: The chalk's exact partner was not obvious to me. I guessed the handset, but compatibility feedback automatically used it at the request desk instead.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue: the volunteers' decisions and the contrast between the formal appeal and immediate local action made me curious about what happens at dawn.
